searchText: It has been brought up before, and may be reasonable as a long term strategy (e.g., after 1559), but it will likely break most tooling so it isn't considered a viable short term option. For example, we may say something like "legacy transactions will stop working in a year. After that you'll need to submit them through a precompile". it just hadn't occured to me yet and it seems like a nice way to both be able to fully deprecate them **and** still have a route where the long dormant paper wallet pre-signed something something legacy transaction can still be executed, albeit maybe with a little hoop jumping. Re: https://discordapp.com/channels/595666850260713488/779922457631916064/781068173079347220 <@!211091239112671234> any chance you could take a look at the document there? It would be great to get some initial feedback from you and the Geth team on this prior to the ACD meeting. <@!489256758989029405> as well.
